value.rationale: Exact covariance rank loss for every finite site set in a natural positivity-preserving approximation family is an interpretable structural invariant for kernel sampling, and the sharp four-point design quantifies regularization of a genuine singularity. The result is not a reparametrization or numerical one-off; its exhaustive antipodal-pair case split includes all degrees, positive kernels and configurations. Significance rests on complete finite-configuration singularity geometry and an exact condition-number optimum, beyond re-proving known positive semidefiniteness.
